prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Create ONE production city-map building sprite for tianshu, early-to-middle Qing Jiangnan region, 17th–18th century. The supplied Song Jiangnan image is a REFERENCE for the realistic material detail density and camera, NOT an edit target: generate an entirely new building of the stated type. Orthographic camera yaw45 elevation30; 2:1 dimetric ground projection, BOTH ground axes slopes precisely +0.5 and -0.5, verticals upright, parallel edges, NO perspective. Original South-facing entrance faces screen LOWER LEFT. True transparent RGBA background, all subject and short contact shadow completely inside canvas with at least 10% transparent margins. Very thin flat rectangular ground footprint with all three front ground corners clear; no thick diorama plinth. Realistic ancient architecture sprite, softly weathered off-white lime plaster, charcoal gray small fired clay roof tiles, gray brick/stone bases, dark timber and fine wood lattice windows. Modest Qing-style brick gate surrounds and restrained small carved trim; no ubiquitous imperial gilding, no giant ornamental roof curls. Light screen UPPER LEFT, small soft contact shadow screen LOWER RIGHT. NO sky, horizon, landscape, road outside footprint, humans, animals, calligraphy, labels, pseudo-writing, numbers, signage, watermark, checkers, plastic, cartoon, modern objects. This is an original generic game composite inspired by regional surviving Ming/Qing architectural forms, NOT a restoration of a named monument. ONE utilitarian Qing Jiangnan GUARDHOUSE, a simple gray-tiled single-storey white-plaster two-bay building with dark timber front door, one lattice window, bench under a short covered porch. NO text, no weapons, no city gate tower. Correct footprint7x5m and EXACT2:1 orthographic ground. Ground LEFT=(200,600), FRONT=(900,950), RIGHT=(1400,700), BACK=(700,350). These target coordinates define a thin parallelogram7:5; uniformly scale down/translate the whole asset to fit transparent margin, never change shape. Both visible pad edge angles26.565deg, slopes+0.500,-0.500. The long front edge must NOT become too horizontal. Build walls strictly parallel to this ground, vertical posts. No garden or wall complex.
